name: resource-monitor-ng
description: Ultra-lightweight, zero-overhead Linux & macOS Apple Silicon resource monitor for VS Code status bar.

commands.title: Resource Monitor: Toggle Tooltip Mode (Static / Live)
Resource Monitor: Toggle Static Tooltip Auto-Refresh
Resource Monitor: Toggle CPU Tooltip Layout (Table / List)
Resource Monitor: Toggle System Load Format (Percent / Value)
Resource Monitor: Toggle Multi-Disk Display Mode (All / MostFull)

resmon.show.cpuusage.description: Toggles the display of CPU usage percentage.

resmon.show.cpufreq.description: Toggles the display of CPU frequency (Linux) or system load average (macOS).

resmon.show.cputemp.description: Toggles the display of CPU temperature.

resmon.show.mem.description: Toggles the display of memory consumption.

resmon.show.battery.description: Toggles the display of battery percentage remaining.

resmon.show.disk.description: Toggles the display of disk space information.

resmon.show.settings.description: Shows the settings (gear) widget after the metrics: its tooltip holds the quick toggles, a click opens the settings panel.

resmon.order.description: Left-to-right order of the status bar widgets: cpu (CPU usage), freq (CPU frequency on Linux, system load on macOS), temp, mem, battery, disk. Missing entries keep their default position.

resmon.disk.format.description: Format for displaying disk space information.

resmon.disk.drives.description: Specific mount paths to monitor. If empty, monitors the workspace root or '/'.

resmon.disk.multiDisplay.description: Multi-disk status bar display mode: 'All' displays compact metrics for all monitored disks; 'MostFull' displays only the single volume with highest utilization.

cpu.description: CPU usage: status bar interval: how often it is read and its text updated (ms).

freq.description: System load (macOS) or CPU frequency (Linux): status bar interval: how often it is read and its text updated (ms).

temp.description: Temperature: status bar interval: how often it is read and its text updated (ms). Measured minimum 8400 ms.

mem.description: Memory: status bar interval: how often it is read and its text updated (ms).

battery.description: Battery: status bar interval: how often it is read and its text updated (ms).

disk.description: Disk space: status bar interval: how often it is read and its text updated (ms).

resmon.statusBarMs.markdownDescription:
**Status bar interval per section, in milliseconds**: how often each section reads its data and updates its text. Every read has a cost, so these intervals set the extension's CPU use.

- Range 200 ms to 1 h. Measured minimum: temperature 8400 ms; below it, that section alone would use more than the extension's whole CPU budget (see `#resmon.allowFastRefresh#`); CPU usage, system load / CPU frequency, memory, battery and disk can go down to 200 ms.
- Sections: `cpu` CPU usage, `freq` system load (macOS) or CPU frequency (Linux), `temp` temperature, `mem` memory, `battery`, `disk`.
- A section left out uses its default; for `cpu`, `freq` and `mem` the older `#resmon.updatefrequencyms#` applies if you set it.
- Live tooltips follow these intervals; Static tooltips use `#resmon.tooltipMs#`.

freq.description: System load (macOS) or CPU frequency (Linux): Static tooltip interval (ms).

resmon.tooltipMs.markdownDescription:
**Tooltip interval per section, in milliseconds (Static mode)**: how often each tooltip is rebuilt from the latest reading while `#resmon.tooltip.mode#` is `Static` and `#resmon.tooltip.autoRefresh#` is on.

- A tooltip never refreshes faster than its section's status bar interval (`#resmon.statusBarMs#`): there is no newer reading to show, so a shorter value applies as the status bar interval.
- Not used in Live mode (tooltips follow the status bar) or with auto-refresh off (tooltips refresh on click).
- Range 200 ms to 1 h. Sections as in `#resmon.statusBarMs#`.

resmon.allowFastRefresh.markdownDescription: **Performance impact.** Allows status bar intervals below the measured minimum (temperature 8400 ms), down to 200 ms. The minimums are the intervals at which one section's reads alone would use the extension's whole CPU budget (0.5% of one core), measured on an Apple M4 (a temperature reading costs about 42 ms of CPU across the system); below them that section costs more CPU time and energy than the whole extension should. Values set below a minimum are kept and apply whenever this is on.

resmon.updatefrequencyms.markdownDescription: Deprecated: single status bar interval in milliseconds (200-15000), replaced by `#resmon.statusBarMs#`. Still applies to CPU usage, system load / frequency and memory while `#resmon.statusBarMs#` does not set them.
resmon.updatefrequencyms.deprecationMessage: Replaced by resmon.statusBarMs (one interval per section). Still applies to cpu, freq and mem until resmon.statusBarMs sets them.

resmon.priority.description: Base priority for status bar positioning. Higher values place it further to the left; lower or negative values place it further to the right.

resmon.tooltip.mode.markdownDescription: `Static` rebuilds each tooltip on click and, with `#resmon.tooltip.autoRefresh#`, every `#resmon.tooltipMs#` of its section (fewer changes while you hover). `Live` rebuilds it with every status bar update of its section (`#resmon.statusBarMs#`); temperature only when a new sensor reading arrives. Each tooltip shows the time of the reading it displays (with tenths of a second below 1000 ms).

resmon.tooltip.autoRefresh.markdownDescription: Static mode only: rebuild tooltips automatically every `#resmon.tooltipMs#` of their section. When off, Static tooltips refresh only on click.

resmon.refreshMs.markdownDescription: Deprecated (pre-release): replaced by `#resmon.tooltipMs#` for tooltips and `#resmon.statusBarMs#` for reads. Still read until those are set.
resmon.refreshMs.deprecationMessage: Replaced by resmon.tooltipMs (tooltips) and resmon.statusBarMs (reads). Still read until those are set.

resmon.refreshSeconds.markdownDescription: Deprecated (pre-release): seconds per section, replaced by `#resmon.tooltipMs#` and `#resmon.statusBarMs#`.
resmon.refreshSeconds.deprecationMessage: Replaced by resmon.tooltipMs and resmon.statusBarMs (milliseconds). Still read until those are set.

resmon.tooltip.cpuLayout.description: Layout style for CPU per-core breakdown in tooltips: 'Table' for compact side-by-side grid; 'List' for vertical cluster sections.

resmon.loadFormat.description: Format for displaying System Load Average on Darwin: 'Percent' (normalized capacity across available cores) or 'Value' (raw POSIX queue depth).

scripts.test:linux: node -e "require('esbuild').buildSync({ entryPoints: ['test/smoke-linux.ts'], outfile: 'dist/test-smoke-linux.cjs', bundle: true, platform: 'node', format: 'cjs' });" && node dist/test-smoke-linux.cjs && rm -f dist/test-smoke-linux.cjs
scripts.test:integration: node -e "require('esbuild').buildSync({ entryPoints: ['test/integration.ts'], outfile: 'dist/test-integration.cjs', bundle: true, platform: 'node', format: 'cjs', external: ['*.node'] });" && node dist/test-integration.cjs && rm -f dist/test-integration.cjs
